<section id="cli-guide">
<h1>CLI guide</h1>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> is a global option, so place it before the subcommand:
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger</span> <span class="pre">--json</span> <span class="pre">read</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code> rather than <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger</span> <span class="pre">read</span> <span class="pre">--json</span></code>.</p>
<section id="ledger-boundary">
<h2>Ledger boundary</h2>
<p>Archledger is an isolated architecture ledger. It stores architecture records,
record links, and source references. It does not import/export behavior specs,
enforce SDD policy, or coordinate external ledgers.</p>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">trace</span></code> for architecture retrieval, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">check</span></code> for ledger
validation, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source</span></code> for change tracking, and mutation commands under
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">record</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">refs</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">links</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ac</span></code>. JSON Schemas are returned with
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">jsonschema</span> <span class="pre">--target</span> <span class="pre">TARGET</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">install</span></code> creates optional
integration scaffolds and refuses overwrites unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--force</span></code> is supplied.</p>
</section>
<section id="init-initialize-a-workspace">
<span id="init"></span><h2><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">init</span></code> — Initialize a workspace</h2>
<p>Creates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger.toml</span></code>, the state directory, section stubs, record-type
subdirectories, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">storage.yaml</span></code> in one step.</p>
<p>Fails if a config file already exists in the target workspace.</p>
<section id="synopsis">
<h3>Synopsis</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>OPTIONS<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="quick-start">
<h3>Quick start</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Markdown project</span>
archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--source-format<span class="w"> </span>markdown

<span class="c1"># AsciiDoc project (default when --source-format is omitted)</span>
archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--source-format<span class="w"> </span>asciidoc
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="what-init-creates">
<h3>What init creates</h3>
<p>Running <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">init</span></code> produces:</p>
<ul>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger.toml</span></code> — project configuration (see <a class="reference internal" href="../configuration/"><span class="doc">Configuration</span></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;archledger-dir&gt;/</span></code> — state directory (default <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.archledger</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;archledger-dir&gt;/sections/</span></code> — 12 arc42 section stubs (default <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_0001</span></code> through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_0012</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;archledger-dir&gt;/records/</span></code> — typed subdirectories:</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">building_blocks</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">concepts</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">constraints</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">contexts</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">decisions</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">deployment</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">diagrams</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">glossary</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">quality_goals</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">quality_requirements</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">quality_scenarios</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">requirements</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">risks</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">runtime</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">stakeholders</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">strategy</span></code></p>
</li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;archledger-dir&gt;/archive/</span></code> — for archived records</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;archledger-dir&gt;/build/</span></code> — default build output directory</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;archledger-dir&gt;/storage.yaml</span></code> — ledger counter state</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Section files are numbered by configured <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[ids]</span></code> format (default <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_0001</span></code> through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_0012</span></code>) matching the 12
major arc42 sections:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Introduction and Goals</p></li>
<li><p>Architecture Constraints</p></li>
<li><p>Context and Scope</p></li>
<li><p>Solution Strategy</p></li>
<li><p>Building Block View</p></li>
<li><p>Runtime View</p></li>
<li><p>Deployment View</p></li>
<li><p>Cross-cutting Concepts</p></li>
<li><p>Architecture Decisions</p></li>
<li><p>Quality Requirements</p></li>
<li><p>Risks and Technical Debt</p></li>
<li><p>Glossary</p></li>
</ol>
<p>After init, add starter content with:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>seed<span class="w"> </span>arc42-minimal
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="core-options">
<h3>Core options</h3>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--source-format</span> <span class="pre">FORMAT</span></code>
Canonical source dialect: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">markdown</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">asciidoc</span></code>.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">asciidoc</span></code>.
Determines file extensions, default build output name, and template
rendering for all generated section stubs.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--archledger-dir</span> <span class="pre">PATH</span></code>
State directory to create, relative to the config path unless absolute.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.archledger</span></code>.
Use an absolute path to store state outside the project tree.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--project-name</span> <span class="pre">TEXT</span></code>
Stable project identity stored in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger.toml</span></code>.
Defaults to the workspace directory basename (slug-normalized).</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--project-uuid</span> <span class="pre">TEXT</span></code>
Stable project UUID. Auto-generated when omitted.
Must be a valid UUID format.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--id-prefix</span> <span class="pre">TEXT</span></code>
Ledger ID prefix for generated section/record IDs (for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ta</span></code>).
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--id-width</span> <span class="pre">N</span></code>
Minimum digit width for generated ledger IDs.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">4</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--id-segment-mode</span> <span class="pre">MODE</span></code>
Ledger ID segment mode: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">type</span></code>.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="build-options">
<h3>Build options</h3>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-default-format</span> <span class="pre">FORMAT</span></code>
Default build output format: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">markdown</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">asciidoc</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pdf</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docx</span></code>.
When omitted, defaults to the source format.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-default-output</span> <span class="pre">FILENAME</span></code>
Default build output filename.
When omitted, defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">architecture.&lt;ext&gt;</span></code> matching the source format.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-default-output-dir</span> <span class="pre">DIR</span></code>
Build output directory, relative to the config path.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-include-draft</span></code>
Include draft records in build output.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-include-superseded</span></code>
Include superseded records in build output.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-strict</span></code>
Enable strict build mode.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-keep-intermediate</span></code>
Keep intermediate build files.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-converter</span> <span class="pre">TOOL</span></code>
Build converter tool: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pandoc</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">asciidoctor</span></code>.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-pdf-engine</span> <span class="pre">ENGINE</span></code>
PDF engine for pandoc builds.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--build-reference-docx</span> <span class="pre">PATH</span></code>
Reference docx template for pandoc builds.</p>
</section>
<section id="diagram-options">
<h3>Diagram options</h3>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--diagrams</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-diagrams</span></code>
Enable diagram support.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-diagrams</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--diagram-renderer</span> <span class="pre">RENDERER</span></code>
Diagram renderer: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pass-through</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mermaid-cli</span></code>, or
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">asciidoctor-diagram</span></code>.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pass-through</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--diagram-default-type</span> <span class="pre">TYPE</span></code>
Default diagram type: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ascii</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unicode</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">svgbob</span></code>, or
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mermaid</span></code>.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--diagram-output-dir</span> <span class="pre">DIR</span></code>
Diagram output directory.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">diagrams</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--diagram-image-format</span> <span class="pre">FORMAT</span></code>
Diagram image format: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">svg</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">png</span></code>.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">svg</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--diagram-kroki-url</span> <span class="pre">URL</span></code>
Kroki server URL (reserved for future renderers).</p>
</section>
<section id="arc42-options">
<h3>arc42 options</h3>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--arc42-title</span> <span class="pre">TEXT</span></code>
arc42 template title.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Architecture</span> <span class="pre">Documentation</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--arc42-language</span> <span class="pre">CODE</span></code>
arc42 template language.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--arc42-template-version</span> <span class="pre">VERSION</span></code>
arc42 template version.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">9.0-EN</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--arc42-include-help</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-arc42-include-help</span></code>
Include arc42 help sections in generated section stubs.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-arc42-include-help</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="tracking-options">
<h3>Tracking options</h3>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--tracking</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-tracking</span></code>
Enable source tracking.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--tracking</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--tracking-scanner</span> <span class="pre">SCANNER</span></code>
Tracking scanner: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">git</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">filesystem</span></code>.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--tracking-state-file</span> <span class="pre">FILENAME</span></code>
Tracking state filename.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source-state.json</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--tracking-max-file-bytes</span> <span class="pre">N</span></code>
Maximum file size in bytes for tracking.
Default: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">1000000</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--tracking-include</span> <span class="pre">GLOB</span></code>
Glob pattern for tracking includes. Repeatable.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--tracking-exclude</span> <span class="pre">GLOB</span></code>
Glob pattern for tracking excludes. Repeatable.</p>
</section>
<section id="examples">
<h3>Examples</h3>
<p>Minimal Markdown project with build output at the project root:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--source-format<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--build-default-output<span class="w"> </span>ARCHITECTURE.md<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--build-default-output-dir<span class="w"> </span>.
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>AsciiDoc project with diagram support, German arc42 template, and custom
tracking excludes:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--source-format<span class="w"> </span>asciidoc<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--diagrams<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--diagram-default-type<span class="w"> </span>mermaid<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--arc42-title<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Meine Systemarchitektur&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--arc42-language<span class="w"> </span>de<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--tracking-exclude<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;vendor/**&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--tracking-exclude<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;**/__pycache__/**&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>External state directory:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--archledger-dir<span class="w"> </span>/shared/archledger-state
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Segmented IDs for record-type-based naming:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--source-format<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="w"> </span>--id-segment-mode<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">type</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>JSON output for automation:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--source-format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="other-commands">
<span id="id1"></span><h2>Other commands</h2>
<p>Inspect the current source state:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>paths
archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>status
archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>check
archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>doctor
archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">read</span><span class="w"> </span>--body<span class="w"> </span>--include-drafts
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Track implementation drift:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>snapshot<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span>after-archledger-update
archledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>changed
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Create records:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>new<span class="w"> </span>requirement<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Render architecture document&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>proposed
archledger<span class="w"> </span>new<span class="w"> </span>adr<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Treat source fragments as canonical&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>proposed
archledger<span class="w"> </span>new<span class="w"> </span>diagram<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Runtime login flow&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--section<span class="w"> </span>runtime_view<span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>proposed
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Archive and repair:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>archive<span class="w"> </span>al_0022<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;obsolete after al_0041&quot;</span>
archledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor
archledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor<span class="w"> </span>--repair
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Renumber IDs and references:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>renumber<span class="w"> </span>--prefix<span class="w"> </span>ta<span class="w"> </span>--width<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">3</span>
archledger<span class="w"> </span>renumber<span class="w"> </span>--prefix<span class="w"> </span>ta<span class="w"> </span>--width<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">3</span><span class="w"> </span>--apply
archledger<span class="w"> </span>renumber<span class="w"> </span>--id-segment-mode<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">type</span>
archledger<span class="w"> </span>renumber<span class="w"> </span>--id-segment-mode<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">type</span><span class="w"> </span>--apply
archledger<span class="w"> </span>renumber<span class="w"> </span>--id-segment-mode<span class="w"> </span>none<span class="w"> </span>--apply
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">check</span></code> is read-only. It validates numbering and integrity but does not mutate counters or source files.</p>
<p>Build output:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>archledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
archledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>asciidoc
archledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>html<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
